The '''2022 Copa Libertadores final stages''' were played from 28 June to 29 October 2022.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=https://www.ole.com.ar/futbol-internacional/libertadores/calendario-libertadores-sudamericana-2022_0_pfbOeTQat.html|title=El calendario de la Libertadores y la Sudamericana 2022|work=[[Olé (sports newspaper)|Olé]]|date=17 August 2021|access-date=17 May 2022}}</ref> A total of 16 teams competed in the final stages to decide the champions of the [[2022 Copa Libertadores]],<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/documentos/manual-de-clubes-reglamento-conmebol-libertadores-2022/|title=Manual de Clubes / Reglamento CONMEBOL Libertadores 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref> with the final played in [[Guayaquil]], Ecuador at [[Estadio Monumental Isidro Romero Carbo]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/montevideo-sera-la-sede-de-las-finales-unicas-de-la-conmebol|title=Montevideo será la sede de las finales únicas de la CONMEBOL|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=13 May 2021|language=es}}</ref>

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
Starting from the round of 16, the teams played a [[single-elimination tournament]] with the following rules:<ref name="regulations"/>
*In the round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals, each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2). If tied on aggregate, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] was not played, and a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] was used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.3).
*The final was played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by CONMEBOL, with the higher-seeded team designated as the "home" team for administrative purposes (Regulations Article 2.2.3.5). If tied after regulation, 30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] would be played. If still tied after extra time, a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.4).<section end=Format />

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the round of 16 was held on 27 May 2022, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]) at the CONMEBOL Convention Center in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref name="Final stages draw">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/se-viene-el-sorteo-de-los-octavos-de-final/ |title=Se viene el sorteo de los Octavos de Final|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=23 May 2022|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/cruces-de-alto-voltaje-en-los-octavos-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-2022/|title=Cruces de alto voltaje en los octavos de la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=27 May 2022|language=es}}</ref> For the round of 16, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (A–H) between a group winner (Pot 1) and a group runner-up (Pot 2), with the group winners hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association or the same group could be drawn into the same tie (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2).<ref name="regulations"/><section end=Draw />

The first legs were played on 30 and 31 August, and the second legs were played on 6 and 7 September 2022.<ref name="SF_fixture">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/fixture-de-las-semifinales-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2022/|title=Fixture de las Semifinales de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=12 August 2022|language=es}}</ref><ref name="SF_fixture_pdf">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Fixture_CONMEBOL-Libertadores_SEMIFINAL-1.pdf|title=PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - SEMIFINALES|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=12 August 2022|language=es}}</ref>
